title: Pit Firing
source_quote: *Firings are done throughout the year as student interest and resources permit*
evidence_sentence: Pit firings happen throughout the year based on student interest and resource availability.
evidence_quote: At Earth Center Pottery, we built an above ground pit out of fire bricks. This type of pit can be disassembled, enlarged, reduced and moved as space requires.
summary: Earth Center Pottery offers pit firing throughout the year as interest and resources permit. Contact the studio for participation details.
how_to_join: Contact Jennifer Miller at 267.218.0290 or earthcenterpottery@yahoo.com
